themes.name: Foundry
themes.description: GitHub-neutral baseline — white paper, near-black ink, Primer-blue links, quiet gray rules. Restraint, perfected.
themes.highlights: Hex-accurate Primer palette in both modes incl. all 7 syntax tokens; gradient heading bar replaced with flat 1px hairline rules + bordered h1, links bare until hover; blue active-indicator bars over gray washes in sidebar/TOC and fill-less GitHub-alert admonitions at a committed 6px radius

themes.name: Ledger
themes.description: Cream academic serif in the Tufte tradition — warm paper, ink prose, oxblood links, hairline rules, quiet code.
themes.highlights: Ledger rule system: double rule under the H1, booktabs tables, double-rule footer and flyout head, hairline everything else; italic small-caps navigation with printer's marks (§ ❧ †) replacing emoji in admonitions, oxblood italic active states instead of solid blocks; 44rem book measure with oldstyle figures in prose and an understated ink-first syntax palette in both modes

themes.name: Broadsheet
themes.description: Newspaper editorial — Playfair masthead, Oxford ink rules, a red drop cap, and a night-edition dark mode.
themes.fonts: Playfair Display, Source Serif 4, Courier Prime
themes.highlights: Red Playfair drop cap on the opening paragraph with an end-of-story slug closing the article; thick-thin Oxford rule under the masthead/h1/footer plus 4px double rules under h2s, TOC head, pager and flyout; all-square pressroom-ink system — typewriter wire-report code boxes, dotted-leader listings tables, manicule/pilcrow notice boxes, double-framed classified-ad flyout

themes.name: Swissgrid
themes.description: International Typographic Style — Helvetica grid, black on white, one hot Swiss-red accent, oversized section numbers.
themes.fonts: Helvetica/Inter, Inter Tight, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Baseline-grid 1px ruled background on page and sidebar; counter-driven oversized red section numbers (01/02) above 4px-ruled h2s; all-square geometry with hard red offset shadows on flyout, launcher, and pager hovers plus monochrome+red keyword syntax palette

themes.name: Manuscript
themes.description: A quiet Garamond book page — warm paper, soft ink, sepia rubrication, small-caps subheads, fleuron section marks.
themes.highlights: Letterspaced small-caps h2/h3 plus a rubricated sepia drop cap and old-style numerals; centered fleuron (❦) ornamental hr echoed in the footer colophon, with double-rule masthead/footer/flyout frames; manuscript-ink syntax palette (rubric-red keywords, bottle-green strings, indigo callables) and marginalia admonition marks (※ ❧ †) on an all-square, faint laid-paper page

themes.name: Solar
themes.description: Solarized precision — low-eyestrain paper tones, blue/cyan/orange accents, mono labels, technical calm in both modes.
themes.highlights: Full contrast-tuned Solarized palette in light-dark() pairs (base3 paper / base03 teal) with canonical green/cyan/blue/yellow/magenta syntax mapping; selective-contrast chrome — emphasized base02/base2 headings, blue-tinted square nav bars, mono uppercase yellow micro-labels and terminal-glyph admonitions; solar signatures — sunrise wash atop the page, orange sun glyph on the logo, yellow code-block gutter, solarized-spectrum cap strip on the flyout

themes.name: Drift
themes.description: Floaty slate-blue comfort dark for long reading — soft glows in place of borders, gentle elevation, relaxed Plex type.
themes.fonts: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Glow-instead-of-border chrome (hairline rings + layered soft shadows on code, cards, flyout, admonitions); floating atmosphere via fixed radial light pools and pill-shaped glowing nav/TOC actives; hushed blue-axis pastel syntax palette with a misty-slate light mode counterpart

themes.name: Hollow
themes.description: Dark violet space — neon pink headings, violet links, a quiet starfield, and razor-square midnight chrome.
themes.highlights: CSS-only starfield backdrop (two tiled star layers + violet/pink nebula washes, fixed attachment, transparent sidebar floating over it); strict neon discipline — pink reserved for headings/active markers with a dark-mode-only h1 glow, violet for links, radius 0 everywhere; midnight syntax palette redesigned in both modes (neon-pink keywords, violet callables, aqua strings) with geometric admonition glyphs replacing emoji

themes.name: Hearth
themes.description: Warm cream & brick-red fireside docs — Fraunces headings, amber code blocks, ember-glow dark mode.
themes.highlights: Toasted amber code panels with warm inset highlight and brown-tinted shadows on soft 12px corners; ember-lit dark mode (roasted brown room, terracotta accents, honey syntax) plus firelight radial gradients on the page body; Fraunces serif chrome throughout — brick h1/h2 with fading ember rules, italic serif blockquote cushion, candle/coffee/fire admonition icons, glowing-coal launcher button

themes.name: Futura Editorial
themes.description: Normal-weight geometric Futura headings over Noto Sans body — clean white, near-black ink, one restrained red accent.
themes.highlights: Weight-400 Jost/Futura headings with tight tracking and a red tick above the h1; all radii zeroed with solid ink hairline rules on masthead, h2, thead, and footer; near-monochrome Space Mono syntax palette reserving the single red accent for keywords, emoji admonition icons swapped for uppercase typographic labels

themes.name: Phosphor
themes.description: Green CRT terminal — phosphor glow, scanlines, inverse-video nav, monospace everything.
themes.highlights: Fixed CRT overlay: scanlines + tube vignette via body pseudo-elements, tuned per mode with light-dark(); phosphor-glow text-shadow on VT323 headings with blinking block cursors on the logo and h1 prompt; ASCII shape language — box-drawing h2 rules, [i]/[+]/[!] admonition badges in a green/cyan/amber phosphor triad, dashed table rules, zero radius everywhere

themes.name: E-Ink
themes.description: E-reader grayscale: paper-device calm, crisp 1px rules, Literata prose, one dark-teal accent — no shadows, no color.
themes.fonts: Literata, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Shadowless square chrome drawn entirely with crisp 1px gray hairlines, double book-rule under the h1 and an e-reader-dialog flyout with press-inversion buttons; hue-free syntax palette where roles read by lightness, weight, and slant — only strings borrow the functional teal; monochrome admonition cards with text-glyph badges (§ ✳ ▲), uppercase device labels, and grayscale-filtered emoji chrome

themes.name: Blueprint
themes.description: Cyanotype engineering sheet — white line-work, mono-caps labels on prussian grid paper, yellow highlighter callouts.
themes.highlights: CSS-only grid-paper background with 24px minor and 120px major rules on page, sidebar, and flyout; title-block header with framed DWG logo cell, REV C stamp, and mono-caps nav plus dashed construction-line borders and square offset shadows everywhere (radius 0); drafting-annotation content system — yellow leading-zero section counters on H2s, FIG-labeled code sheet, schedule-style table, and SHEET 01/01 footer strip

themes.name: Washi
themes.description: Warm washi paper, sumi ink, and ai-iro indigo seals — quiet Japanese stationery for calm documentation.
themes.fonts: Zen Kaku Gothic New, Shippori Mincho, M PLUS 1 Code
themes.highlights: CSS-only paper grain (two fleck sizes + fiber lines, distinct vertical-fiber sidebar sheet); indigo hanko stamp system — tilted 藍 seal on h1, kanji admonition chips, square stamp launcher, asymmetric two-tone h2 rules; all-square shape language with 1.95 prose leading and an aizome-dyed indigo-night dark mode

themes.name: Sumi
themes.description: Sumi-e ink on washi — bold mincho brush headings, deep black strokes, one vermillion hanko seal accent.
themes.fonts: Shippori Mincho B1, Zen Kaku Gothic New, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Tapered clip-path ink-brush strokes under h1 and above every h2, sealed with a red square; vermillion hanko squares as the recurring accent — nav markers, code-corner seals, footer signature, and a square 印 launcher stamp; ink-slab code blocks (dark in both modes) with monochrome-wash syntax plus seal-red keywords and hard offset stamp shadows

themes.name: Sakura
themes.description: Cherry-blossom pastels — blush white, sakura pink, plum ink; petal-soft corners and a quiet yozakura dark mode.
themes.fonts: M PLUS Rounded 1c, Quicksand, M PLUS 1 Code
themes.highlights: Petal-soft radius system: pill sidebar/TOC navs, 16px code blocks, blossom-watermarked flyout card; pink-tinted code blocks with a hanami syntax palette (rose keywords, leaf strings, wisteria callables); CSS-only blush washes on the page body that read as lantern glow in the yozakura dark mode, plus flower-dingbat admonitions and a three-petal hr

themes.name: Matcha
themes.description: Green tea ceremony — deep matcha on warm cream, mincho headings, zen whitespace, tea-foam surfaces in both modes.
themes.fonts: Zen Kaku Gothic New, Shippori Mincho, M PLUS 1 Code
themes.highlights: Faint CSS-only enso ring + tea-foam gradient wash over cream/charcoal-green pages; square shoji shape language (all radii 0) with a chashaku-scoop h2 rule that dissolves like foam; Shippori Mincho ceremony headings, zen glyph admonition marks, and a matcha-lipped flyout bowl

themes.name: Fjord
themes.description: Polar-night blue under a faint aurora — frost-cyan accents, icy borders, snow-white text. Cold nordic calm.
themes.highlights: Fixed aurora glow (teal-to-violet radial gradients) over the polar-night page with matching aurora hairlines on the header, h2 rules, and flyout cap; crystalline shape language — zero-radius admonitions/cards, icy frost-tinted borders and ice-pane code blocks with top-edge sheen; frost-family syntax palette and aurora-teal links/nav/TOC actives tuned for 4.5:1+ in both the arctic-night and daylight-glacier modes

themes.name: Barnwood
themes.description: Warm umber and cream with harvest orange, aqua, and rye accents — chunky square joinery and vintage terminal glow.
themes.fonts: Zilla Slab, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Always-dark vintage-terminal code panels with scanlines, amber glow, and a tty corner badge; CSS-only wood-plank seams and grain on page, header, sidebar, and flyout; all-square joinery with chunky borders and hard orange offset shadows on cards, buttons, and launcher

themes.name: Nocturne
themes.description: Purple midnight — velvet aubergine depths, lavender links, and muted gold hairlines. Elegant, never neon.
themes.fonts: Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Gold hairline rules everywhere (h1/h2 fading rules, sidebar/TOC active markers, table header, header/footer bands) with a near-square radius decision; velvet-depth surfaces via fixed moonlit radial glows plus gradient-lit code blocks, pager cards, and a jewel-box flyout; serif display layer (Cormorant Garamond h1/h2, italic lead, blockquote, pager titles) over a Manrope reading face with a moonlit 7-token syntax palette in both modes

themes.name: Abyss
themes.description: Deep-ocean navy with bioluminescent cyan — depth-graded backgrounds and glowing links for pressure-calm reading.
themes.highlights: Fixed depth-gradient water column with marine-snow particle layers; bioluminescent cyan glow on link/nav/TOC hover with sonar-ping active states; corner-lit pressure-hull code blocks with coral/teal/violet deep-sea syntax palette

themes.name: Aurora
themes.description: Night-sky docs beneath the northern lights — teal-to-violet aurora gradients, star-dust sky, feather-light type.
themes.highlights: Aurora gradient text on h1/logo/flyout title via background-clip; viewport-fixed CSS-only star-dust field with three aurora glows behind a frosted header and translucent sidebar; teal-to-violet gradient borders on active nav/TOC items, code-block frame, pager hover, and the flyout card — with a dark night-window code block in both modes

themes.name: Cyberdeck
themes.description: Neon terminal for night ops — magenta and cyan on near-black, clipped corners, glitch underlines, mono caps headings.
themes.highlights: Clipped-corner panels (code, admonitions, pager, flyout, launcher) with drop-shadow neon glows surviving the clip; glitch h1 — chromatic-aberration text-shadow plus offset magenta/cyan segmented underline; terminal code blocks stay dark in BOTH modes with scanlines, cyan spine, and a magenta/cyan/yellow syntax palette over a faint holo-grid page background

themes.name: Vaporwave
themes.description: Retro-future mall at midnight — chrome-gradient headings, hot pink and cyan on deep purple, horizon-grid footer.
themes.highlights: Chrome-gradient uppercase Michroma h1 with pink/cyan palm-tone drop-shadows; perspective horizon-grid footer with venetian-blind sunset sun; square 90s shape language with dual hard-offset pink/cyan shadows on code, pager, and flyout

themes.name: Synthwave
themes.description: Sunset horizon drive — orange-to-magenta heat over dark asphalt, neon horizon rules and warm-glow code.
themes.highlights: Gradient horizon rules under the italic-800 uppercase h1/h2 and header/footer edges, with glow; code blocks rimmed by an orange-to-violet gradient border radiating warm dual-color glow; retro perspective grid on the footer plus gradient-rimmed flyout console and sun-disc launcher

themes.name: Brutalist
themes.description: Raw concrete web — stark black on white, 4px slab borders, zero radius, hazard-orange tape. Structure you can see.
themes.fonts: Archivo Black, Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Inverted header slab with hazard-tape edge, echoed on the shadowless 4px flyout crate; Archivo Black uppercase headings with mono section counters (01 /) and orange // h3 prefixes; always-black code room with white/orange syntax plus stamped full-bleed admonition title bars and full-invert hover on links, pager, sidebar

themes.name: Bauhaus
themes.description: form follows function — paper white, ink black, and primary red, yellow, blue used as structural geometry.
themes.highlights: Kandinsky circle/triangle/square markers across TOC, sidebar groups, list bullets, and admonition title bands; color-blocked admonitions with solid red/yellow/blue header bars over tinted bodies, all corners squared to 0; black poster masthead/footer framed by a tri-color stripe, with a black code block carrying a hard yellow offset shadow in both modes

themes.name: Art Deco
themes.description: Gatsby black and gold — Poiret One display caps, gilt double frames, and a sunburst fan on every rule.
themes.fonts: Poiret One, Jost, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: CSS-only gold sunburst fan on hr via repeating-conic-gradient with radial mask; double-line gilt frames (border + offset outline) on code blocks, pager cards, flyout, and launcher; Poiret One uppercase letterspaced headings with diamond-and-rule ornaments, square geometry throughout

themes.name: Memphis
themes.description: 80s Memphis toy-box: coral, teal, yellow & lilac confetti, squiggle underlines, offset shadow blocks on warm white.
themes.highlights: Coral squiggle SVG edges on header/h1/hr/footer with confetti sidebar pattern; solid offset block shadows with 2px ink outlines on code, admonitions, pager and flyout (tilted -0.6deg); four-color confetti h2 rule plus geometric group markers and glyph icons

themes.name: Halftone
themes.description: Comic print played straight — halftone-dot paper, thick ink outlines, ben-day primaries, speech-bubble admonitions.
themes.highlights: Speech-bubble admonitions with ink-outlined CSS-triangle tails and ben-day dot fills; code blocks on a halftone-dot offset shadow with a CMYK process-ink syntax palette; newsprint dot-grain page with thick ink borders and offset-shadow panels that flip yellow/red between day and night editions

themes.name: Sketchbook
themes.description: A designer's notebook — paper-white pages, graphite ink, wobbly pencil borders, and highlighter-yellow marks.
themes.highlights: Wobbly hand-drawn borders everywhere (uneven radii, dashed pencil rules, squiggle-SVG heading/hr strokes, taped sticky-note admonitions); highlighter-yellow marker swipes on links, strong, h1 underline, nav/TOC active states, and selection; dot-grid paper page with Caveat handwritten headings and a pencil-crayon syntax palette in both modes

themes.name: Academia
themes.description: A LaTeX paper for the web — small-caps title, numbered theorems, booktabs tables, and hyperref navy links.
themes.fonts: STIX Two Text, Cousine (Latin Modern / CMU Typewriter fallbacks)
themes.highlights: amsthm theorem-box admonitions with a shared CSS counter (Theorem/Lemma/Remark run-in heads, italic bodies); centered small-caps h1 with an Abstract lead block, numbered sections, and left-aligned footnote rules; booktabs tables plus a listings-package syntax palette with bold navy keywords

themes.name: Chancery
themes.description: Legal-document formality — §-numbered clauses, ruled sub-sections, forest-green ink on white bond, embossed seal footer.
themes.fonts: Besley, Courier Prime (Century Schoolbook first in stack)
themes.highlights: CSS-counter §-numbered h2/h3 clauses with hairline rules plus Art. I–III roman-numeral sidebar groups; embossed circular seal footer (radial gradient + inset shadows + double ring) with "Given under seal" caption and wax-seal launcher; typewriter Courier Prime code blocks framed as "Exhibit A — annexed hereto" with docket header band

themes.name: Gloss
themes.description: Fashion-editorial white: hairline frames, huge thin Didot headlines, and a single stroke of lipstick red.
themes.fonts: Bodoni Moda, Jost, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Oversized thin didone h1 (opsz-96 Bodoni Moda, clamp to 4.5rem) with lipstick-red tick, italic didone deck, and drop cap; blockquotes rebuilt as centered pull quotes with giant red quotation mark between hairline rules; square everything — hairline-framed code plates/admonitions/pager/flyout, numbered sidebar sections (01/02/03), tracked-caps chrome, monochrome-plus-lipstick syntax palette

themes.name: Scandi
themes.description: Oat linen, sage and clay — hygge minimalism with soft 12px corners, warm charcoal type, no hard black anywhere.
themes.highlights: Linen-weave page texture with birch-plank code panels and warm-brown shadows (no hard black); pill-shaped sage nav/TOC highlights plus a sage-into-clay painted accent bar under H1; clay stitch details — dashed-seam flyout inner border and stitched-dot hr divider

themes.name: Kinfolk
themes.description: Slow-living editorial calm — warm ecru, light serif headlines, terracotta accents, and gallery whitespace.
themes.fonts: Cormorant Garamond, Jost, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Centered light-serif h1 with tracking, italic serif lead and terracotta drop cap over a 44rem gallery measure; everything squared to radius 0 with hairline borders — small-caps plaque admonitions, pull-quote blockquote, short centered hr; quiet terracotta dash/rule markers for active sidebar and TOC states plus a desaturated still-life syntax palette in both modes

themes.name: Onyx
themes.description: Luxury noir — jet black, champagne serif headings, and a single gold hairline accent. Watch-brand restraint.
themes.fonts: Cormorant Garamond, Jost, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Gold 1px hairline rules everywhere (h2 rules, admonition borders thinned to 1px, header/sidebar/footer edges, double-framed flyout); serif upper-roman section numerals on h2 via CSS counters plus oldstyle table figures; all-square shape language (every radius 0) with wide-tracked uppercase labels — the round gold-ringed launcher is the page's only circle

themes.name: Timberline
themes.description: Forest cabin at night — deep pine, cream prose, and lantern-amber links glowing against wood-grain chrome.
themes.highlights: Lantern-warm link glow with amber halo flare on hover plus a breathing lantern launcher; wood-grain surface tint on header/sidebar/footer/flyout via layered repeating gradients with corner lantern-glow page atmosphere; hewn-timber square shape language (radius 0 admonitions/cards) with Bitter slab beams, ember heading rules, and a lantern-lit syntax palette in both modes

themes.name: Adobe
themes.description: Desert southwest sand & terracotta — slab headings, pueblo-stepped admonitions, turquoise & cactus accents.
themes.highlights: Pueblo stepped-corner clip-paths on admonitions, code slab, and flyout with warm drop-shadows that follow the clip; serape stripe bands on header/footer/h2 rules/sidebar group plaques in terracotta-gold-turquoise; dark shadowed-doorway code block kept in both modes with cactus/marigold/turquoise syntax palette

themes.name: Seaglass
themes.description: Coastal morning — fog white, driftwood gray, seaglass teal, frosted-glass chrome and a tide-line hr.
themes.highlights: Frosted-glass header/sidebar/flyout/pager via translucent surfaces + backdrop blur with inset glass highlights; tide-line hr — an SVG-masked wave washed in a seaglass gradient, echoed across the footer top; pebble shape language — pill nav/TOC actives and tumbled 12px cards with a tide-pool syntax palette in both modes

themes.name: Bonbon
themes.description: Candy-shop docs: cream pages, bubblegum & grape pills, candy-stripe rules, chocolate code blocks with pastel syntax.
themes.highlights: Four-sweet candy-stripe rule reused on header edge, H2 rules, hr rope, footer, and flyout ribbon; chocolate-slab code blocks in both modes with candy-button dots and pastel sweet syntax palette; committed pill shape language — pill nav/tags/buttons/inline-code with big 1.1-1.4rem card radii and sprinkle-dot cream wallpaper

themes.name: Macintosh
themes.description: System 7 platinum — pinstriped title bars, 1-bit dither desktop, Chicago-style pixel headings, one rainbow stripe.
themes.fonts: Pixelify Sans, Libre Franklin, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Content, h2s, and code fences styled as System 7 windows with pinstriped title bars, close boxes, and hard offset shadows; 1-bit dither desktop background, dithered hr strips, square lavender-thumb scrollbars, and inverted black/white menu-style selection; six Apple-rainbow hues mapped across the syntax palette plus a single rainbow stripe under the h1

themes.name: Arcade
themes.description: 8-bit cabinet: navy CRT glow, sprite red/yellow/green/cyan, pixel-notched borders, and an insert-coin scoreboard.
themes.fonts: Press Start 2P, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono
themes.highlights: Score-board header with blinking 1UP, HI-SCORE readout and sprite-strip rule; pixel-notched borders via offset box-shadows on code CRT (scanlines + phosphor glow), pager, blockquote dialog box and flyout; chunky four-sprite pixel hr with blinking INSERT COIN footer and yellow menu-cursor nav states

themes.name: HUD
themes.description: Holographic heads-up display — cyan wireframes on black, corner-bracket panels, scan-line sweeps, telemetry labels.
themes.fonts: Rajdhani, Saira Semi Condensed, Share Tech Mono
themes.highlights: Corner-bracket frames on code/admonitions/pager/flyout via 8-layer gradient backgrounds with per-panel bracket color; animated header scan-line sweep plus dark-mode-only full-viewport scanlines and blueprint grid; uppercase mono telemetry micro-labels (SYS.DOCS strap over h1, SRC readout atop code, // sidebar and TOC labels) with a terminal panel that stays dark in both modes

themes.name: Observatory
themes.description: Night-sky atlas: star-field depth, constellation-line rules, nebula violet and comet gold over astronomer's navy.
themes.highlights: Fixed-attachment multi-depth star-dot sky with nebula washes on page, sidebar, code blocks and flyout; constellation-line rules — h1/h2 borders, pager cards and flyout carry glowing gold star nodes joined by fading lines; dashed gold ecliptic hr with sun node, square chart-plate radii, and light mode reimagined as a navy-ink-and-gilt day atlas

themes.name: Botanica
themes.description: Vintage botanical plate — cream stock, deep green ink, engraved double rules, and italic Latin specimen labels.
themes.highlights: Engraved double-rule frames on viewport, header, h1/h2, code blocks and flyout; CSS-counter italic "tabula I/II" Latin plate labels on h2 plus nota-bene/observatio/cave admonition captions with fleuron icons; leaf-motif ❧ list markers, laid-paper background texture, green-ink links blooming to pressed-flower rose on hover

themes.name: Beacon
themes.description: WCAG-AAA high contrast: 7:1+ ink everywhere, 3px focus rings, always-underlined links — clarity as beauty.
themes.highlights: 3px blue focus rings on every interactive element, echoed by pager-card hover; pure black/white ground with AAA-checked #0044cc/#6db3ff blue and #a50000/#ff8f8f dark-red accents, all radii forced to 0; oversized 112.5% rem grid with always-underlined nav/sidebar/TOC links and emoji admonition icons swapped for monochrome glyphs

themes.name: Amberterm
themes.description: Amber phosphor workstation — warm monochrome amber on black; intensity is hierarchy, block cursors mark the beat.
themes.fonts: IBM Plex Mono, IBM Plex Sans
themes.highlights: Single-hue amber ramp drives all syntax/status tokens with brightness as hierarchy; blinking block cursors, $ prompt logo, and ##/### mono heading prefixes; CSS-only scanlines + phosphor glow in dark, umber-on-cream paper adaptation in light, square corners everywhere

themes.name: Zine
themes.description: Punk photocopy zine — newsprint paper, xerox black, stamp red. Typewriter body, rubber-stamp labels, torn-edge rules.
themes.highlights: Rubber-stamp wobbly-border labels (rotated admonition titles, h1 "Nº 49 · DIY PRESS" stamp, red stamp active-nav); torn-edge clip-path hr plus taped-on paste-up cards (tape pseudo-elements, hard offset shadows, tilted typewriter code sheet with red misprint outline); full square shape language with newsprint speckle background and inverted xerox h2 label strips

themes.name: Glacier
themes.description: Ice-pale minimalism — barely-there blues, hairline borders, frost-blue selection, and cold clean air in both modes.
themes.highlights: Signature hairline system: dedicated --gl-line tokens replace every soft border with crisp 1px rules, all radii squared to 0; frosted-glass header/flyout with sparse frost-glow page gradients and frost-blue selection; thin Outfit headings (weight 200 h1) with diamond h2 markers, crystalline admonition glyphs, and a cold-only syntax palette in both modes
